title: Smoke Basin
description: Find low points in a heightmap and flood-fill to identify the three largest basins.
writeup:
## Approach

A heightmap analysis combining local minima detection with BFS flood-fill.

## Part 1

A low point is a cell whose height is strictly less than all of its 4-directional neighbors. The risk level is `height + 1`. Sum all risk levels.

## Part 2

Every non-9 cell belongs to exactly one basin, and each basin flows down to a single low point. BFS from each low point, expanding to all adjacent cells that aren't 9 and haven't been visited. The basin size is the number of cells reached. Sort basin sizes descending and multiply the top three.
